main_text.l: Petitur autem ex utraq; parte Arith-
ratio tàm simplex, quàm mista locum

l.i: iendarum ingens est varietas. Quare ingenium hic
requiritur, quo ex oblatæ quæstionis habitudine, condi-
tionibus atque natura perspicere queas, quid ad eius
quomodo item ceu præuia quadam demonstra-
tionis κατασκευὴ[?], inuolutæ proportionis termini eliciendi[?].

page.notes: The decorated initial I is joined with N ("IN"). The last words of the final paragraph are partly cut off at the right edge, so "eliciendi" is uncertain. The Greek word is read as κατασκευὴ with doubt. The right edge shows fragments of the neighbouring page, which were left out.
